notice: Complete responsibility inventory is not itself semantic or full integration acceptance. Test fixture paths identify inspected witnesses, not automatic proof of every possible input. Historical receipts retain their actual scope.

responsibilities.contract: EntityValues: default, mutable ordered map, conversions and owned/borrowed iteration
responsibilities.review: C++ names the underlying map fields; explicit destination copies replace consuming owned conversions. Constructors/into_map/into_mutation_values delegate to allocator-propagating map operations. Borrowed iteration remains ordered.

responsibilities.contract: GraphOperation and GraphMutationKind alternatives, equality, ordering and for_update
responsibilities.review: All four discriminants preserve source order. Only mutation kind requires source ordering. Boolean helper retains Create/Update mapping.

responsibilities.contract: TraceScopeToken parent, typed frame, node index, clone/equality/Debug and recovery
responsibilities.review: Context-borrowed parents replace Arc. Same-domain copies retain borrowing; explicit destination copies recursively retain parents. Recovery filters Rust whitespace and restores root-first order.

responsibilities.contract: Plan item/batch/plan fields, defaults and derived comparisons/Debug
responsibilities.review: All source fields, old snapshots, optional roots, tokens, counters and visited identities remain distinct. Hash-set diagnostics have unspecified iteration order; singleton exact comparison and multi-member content checks have separate scopes.

responsibilities.contract: push, adjacent batching, grouped counts and size accessors
responsibilities.review: push increments before append; checked Debug overflow becomes a C++ overflow_error. Non-Update fields do not affect batching. Counts read batches, not items. Clearing either collection remains independent.
Ordered present keys only; exact exclusions, including missing exclusions and present NULL. Linear exclusion search preserves semantics without an extra set allocation.

responsibilities.contract: GraphNode fields, construction, clone/equality/Debug including dynamic state
responsibilities.review: Absent/empty comments, dirty sets, snapshots and dynamic carriers remain distinguishable. Explicit destination clone propagates recursively into relations and dynamic definitions/selection/values.

responsibilities.contract: GraphNode builders, relation append/extend, literal ID and comment setters
responsibilities.review: with_operation/with_relations/with_comment avoid member-name collisions. C++ builders mutate and return a reference, rather than moving owned self. Repeated values replace; relation and relations append; empty relation extension retains its map entry. id looks up literal id, not metadata.

Private source helpers are lowered into planner call sites through graph_has_comment/graph_trace_id and conditional token allocation. Preserve positive try_u64 identity and source node_index; Reference inherits parent unchanged. Separate legacy signed-cast callers must not reuse this identity rule.

responsibilities.contract: ScopedCommentNode borrowed hierarchy, Debug and trace materialization
responsibilities.review: Synchronous stack borrow remains distinct from persistent Context token. Root-first traversal and Rust whitespace classification match source.
Exact original assertions are ported; unchanged Rust test executed. C++ additionally tests explicit retained allocation after source destruction.
Six pushes, four adjacent batch groups and three grouped counts retain all original assertion sites.
